hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: In each operation, select any two indices and transform both by transferring parity or value increments.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Check invariant quantities such as total sum or global parity that cannot change under the permitted operations.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: If the global parity invariant matches the target condition, return the minimum operations required.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def minTransformOperations(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    # Operations allow incrementing one element while decrementing another
    # Total sum is invariant. To equalize all elements, each must become total // n
    n = len(nums)
    total = sum(nums)
    if total % n != 0:
        return -1

    target = total // n
    pos_diff = sum(x - target for x in nums if x > target)
    return pos_diff
```
